LOW POLY SCI-FI STATION  v1.0
=============================

90 game-ready low-poly models for space stations and starship interiors:
modular floors, walls and corridors plus furniture and props.
FREE / pay what you want.

FLOORS (16)  - 2 x 2 m tiles, top surface at z=0
  Deck, Deck_Dark, Grate, Grate_Lit, Hazard_Edge, Hazard_Full, LandingPad,
  Hangar, MedBay, Bridge_Carpet, Vent, LightStrip, Hatch, Panel_Open,
  Hex_Tech, Corridor_Arrow

WALLS & STRUCTURE (23)  - walls 2 m wide, 3 m tall, room side faces -Y
  Walls: Panel, Panel_Dark, Ribbed, Pipes, LightStrip, Window, Window_Large,
         Door_Closed, Door_Open, BlastDoor, Hatch, Vent, Console, Monitor,
         Railing, Damaged
  Wall_Corner, Pillar
  Corridor_Straight (4 x 2 m), Corridor_Corner (4 x 4 m), Corridor_T (4 x 4 m)
  Ceiling_Light, Ceiling_Vent (2 x 2 m, pivot on the underside)

FURNITURE & PROPS (51)
  Bridge: Command_Chair, Pilot_Seat, Console_Curved, Console_Standing,
          Holo_Table, Holo_Projector, Comm_Panel
  Crew quarters: Bunk_Bed, Sleep_Pod, Locker, Locker_Row, Mess_Table,
                 Mess_Bench, Stool, Desk_Terminal
  Med bay: Med_Bed, Med_Scanner, Stasis_Pod, Med_Cabinet, Med_Cart
  Engineering: Reactor_Core, Generator, Power_Conduit, Fuse_Box,
               Eng_Control_Panel, Coolant_Tank, Cable_Spool
  Hangar & cargo: Crate_Large, Crate_Small, Crate_Stack, Cargo_Container,
                  Fuel_Barrel, Fuel_Tank, Cargo_Loader, Tool_Cart,
                  Hover_Cart, Landing_Light
  Security: Weapon_Rack, Suit_Locker, ForceField_Cell, Ammo_Crate,
            Defense_Turret, Security_Gate
  Small props: Datapad, Toolbox, Medkit_Wall, Fire_Extinguisher, Wall_Light,
               Floor_Lamp, Hydro_Rack, Plant_Pot

SPECS
  ~26,116 triangles total (about 290 per model on average)
  Real-world scale (metres)
  Floors: pivot at tile centre, top at z=0. Walls: pivot at the base of the
  wall centre-line. Props: pivot bottom-centre.
  Wall-mounted items (Comm_Panel, Fuse_Box, Medkit_Wall, Wall_Light):
  pivot at the wall, facing -Y.
  Flat-shaded, no textures: shared solid-colour materials
  Screens, light strips, reactor, holograms and force fields are emissive

FORMATS
  FBX/  - Unity, Unreal, Godot (scale applied, Y-up)
  GLB/  - Godot, Three.js, Babylon, web viewers
  OBJ/  - universal (with .mtl)
  LowPolySciFiStation.blend - source (Blender 5.1) incl. showcase room

AUTHOR
  Made by Randal Young, Requiem Studios, and Claude (Anthropic).
  Modelled in Blender with code by Claude and reviewed by Randal.
  Every model carries an "author" property (FBX custom property,
  glTF extras, OBJ header comment).

LICENSE
  Free for personal and commercial projects (games, videos, renders).
  Do not resell or redistribute the raw asset files on their own.
  Credit appreciated, not required.
